verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships official SDKs in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java, YAML and HCL, each documented as covering the full surface of Registry providers. The Automation API also lets you use the Pulumi engine itself as an SDK, and there is an ESC SDK for secrets. Hands-on users report building successfully with the Python and TypeScript SDKs and the Automation API, though one wished for better Python client docs. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI spec for the Cloud REST API (probe returned 404), and stronger SDK documentation depth per community feedback.
